card.name: Digits and names inside phone numbers, years, names
card.fires_on: Mostly a hyphen or digit inside a phone number or year (e.g. 1-844-, 19x2), and sometimes a word partway through a proper name or place such as Lake before Union.

modes.label: Inside names and places

card.writes: It suppresses string-quote-plus tokens and mildly promotes odd tokens, so no clear output effect on prose.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of a phone number, a year or a proper name, where the next piece is still to come.
